content:
name: Push to branch checks

on:
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    - release/*
    - feat/*
    - fix/*

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v1
    - name: npm install, and test
      run: |
        npm install
        npm test
      env:
        CI: true
